spans.s: उदक् ind. Above, northward, to the north of, (with abl.)
उदक n. Water, अनीत्वा पंकतां धूलिमुदकं नावतिष्ठते Sis.ii.34, Bg.ii.46.
उदक-अंत m. margin of water, bank, shore, ओदकांतात्स्निग्धो जनोऽनुगंतव्य
इति श्रूयते
Sak.iv.
उदक-आधार m. reservoir, a cistern, a well.
उदक-धर m. a cloud.
उदक-उदंजन m. a water-jar.
उदक-उदर n. dropsy.
उदक-कर्मन् न्।, -कार्यम् न्।, -क्रिया ऋ। n. presentation of water to the deceased ancestors, Yaj.iii.4.
उदक-कर्मन् न्।, -कार्यम् न्।, -क्रिया ऋ। n. presentation of water to the deceased ancestors, Yaj.iii.4.
उदक-क्रिया f. presentation of water to the deceased ancestors, Yaj.iii.4.
उदक-कुंभ m. a water-jar.
उदक-गाह m. entering water, bathing.
उदकेचर m. An aquatic animal.
उदक-द m. an heir, a near kinsman.
उदक-भार m. a yoke for carrying water.
उदक-वज्र m. a thunder-shower.
उदक-शाक n. any aquatic herb.
उदक-शांति f. sprinkling consecrated water over a sick person to allay fever.
उदक-स्पर्श m. touching different parts of the body with water.
उदक(कि)ल a. (f. ला) Watery.
उदक(कि)ल a. (f. ला) Watery.
उदक(कि)ल a. (f. ला) Watery.
उदक्त a. (f. क्ता) Raised up (as from a well), उदक्तमुदकं कूपात् S.K.
उदक्त a. (f. क्ता) Raised up (as from a well), उदक्तमुदकं कूपात् S.K.
उदक्या f. A woman in her courses.

उदग्र a. (f. ग्रा) 1. With elevated top, overtopping; 2. high, elevated (lit. and fig.) उदग्रदशनांशुभिः Sis.ii.21, उदग्रः ख्शत्रस्य शब्दो भुवनेषु रूढः R.ii.53; 3. large, broad, vast, अवंतिनाथोऽयमुदग्रबाहुः R.vi.32; 4. advanced in age; 5. increased, intense, R.ii.71, xiii.50; 6. fierce, R.xi.69; 7. excited, in rapture, मदोदग्राः ककुद्मंतः R.iv.22.

उदग्र a. (f. ग्रा) 1. With elevated top, overtopping; 2. high, elevated (lit. and fig.) उदग्रदशनांशुभिः Sis.ii.21, उदग्रः ख्शत्रस्य शब्दो भुवनेषु रूढः R.ii.53; 3. large, broad, vast, अवंतिनाथोऽयमुदग्रबाहुः R.vi.32; 4. advanced in age; 5. increased, intense, R.ii.71, xiii.50; 6. fierce, R.xi.69; 7. excited, in rapture, मदोदग्राः ककुद्मंतः R.iv.22.
उदच् a. (f. दीची) 1. Turned or going upwards; 2. upper; 3. northern; 4. subsequent.
उदच्-अद्रि m. the northern mountain, i.e. the Himālaya.
उदच्-अयन n. the sun’s progress north of the equator. Cf. उत्तरायण.
उदच्-आवृत्ति f. return to the north, R.viii.33.
उदच्-पथ m. a northern country.
उदच्-प्रवण a. sloping towards the north.
उदच्-भव a. northern.
उदङ्मुख a. facing the north, Megh.i.14.
उदंक n. A leathern vessel.
उदंचन n. 1. A bucket, a pail for drawing water out of a well; 2. rising, ascending; 3. a cover or lid.
उदंजलि a. One who hollows the palms and raises them.
उदंडपाल m. 1. A fish; 2. a snake.
उद्दंड-पाल m. 1. a kind of fish; 2. a kind of serpent. Cf. उद्दंडपाल.

उदन् n. Water.(This word has no forms for the first five cases and is rarely used by itself. It is found only at the beginning, (with the final न् dropped), or at the end of compounds. It is not a separate word but only a substitute for उदक according to some authorities.)
उदन्-कुंभ m. A water-jar, M.ii.182.
उदन्-ज a. aquatic, watery.
उदन्-धान m. 1. a water-jar; 2. a cloud.
उदन्-धि m. 1. the ocean, उदधेरिव निम्नगाशतेष्वभवत्रास्य विमानना क्वचित् R.viii.8; 2. a cloud; 3. a lake; 4. a water-jar.
उदन्-धि˚कन्या, ˚तनया, ˚सुता f. Lakṣmī, the daughter of the occan.
उदन्-धि˚कन्या, ˚तनया, ˚सुता f. Lakṣmī, the daughter of the occan.
उदन्-धि˚कन्या, ˚तनया, ˚सुता f. Lakṣmī, the daughter of the occan.
उदन्-धि˚मेखला f. the earth.
उदन्-धि˚राज m. the king of oceans, i.e. the chief ocean.
उदन्-पात्र n. a water-jug, M.iii.96.
उदन्-पान m.n. a well.
उदन्-पान˚मंडूक m. 1. a frog in a well (lit.); 2. an inexperienced man of limited ideas who knows only his own neighbourhood (fig.).
उदन्-पेष n. a paste.
उदन्-भार m. a water-carrier, i.e. a cloud.
उदन्-मान n. a fiftieth part of an आढक.
उदन्-मेघ m. a watery cloud.
उदन्-लावणिक a. salted.
उदन्-वज्र m. waterspout.
उदन्वत् m. The ocean, R.iv.52, 58, x.6, K.S.vii.73.
उदन्-वसित n. a house, a dwelling.
उदन्-वास m. residence in water, सहस्यरात्रीरुदवासतत्पराK.S.v.26.
उदन्-वाह m. a cloud.
उदन्-वाहन n. a water-vessel.
उदन्-बिंदु m. a drop of water, प्रपेदिरे चिरेण नाभिं प्रथमोदबिंदवः K.S.v.24.
उदन्-शराव m. a water-jar.
उदन्-श्वित् n. butter-milk containing fifty per cent water.
उदन्-हरण m. a vessel for drawing water.

उदाहरण n. 1. Saying, declaring; 2. opening a discourse or conversation, K.S.vi.65; 3. an example, an illustration, समूलघातमघ्नंतः परान्नोद्यंति मानिनः । प्रध्वंसितांधरमसस्तत्रोदाहरणं रविः Sis.ii.33; 4. an illustration considered as a figure of speech by some authors; it closely resembles अर्थांतरन्यास and is very minutely distinguished from it, See R.G. under उदाहरण; 5. the third member in a five-membered syllogism (in logic); 6. a panegyric beginning with some such word as जयति and full of alliterations (it is thus defined in the Pratāparudra- येन केनापि तालेन गद्यपद्यसमन्वितम् । जयत्युपक्रमं मालिन्यादिप्रासविचित्रितम् । तदुदाहरणं नाम विभक्त्यष्टांगसंयुतम् ॥), e.g. चारणेभ्यस्त्वदीयं जयोदाहरणं श्रुत्वा Vikr.i., जयोदाहरणं बाह्वोर्गापयामास किन्नरान् R.iv.78.
उदंत m. 1. Full tidings, intelligence, news, कांतोदंतः सुहृदुपगतः संगमात्किंचिदूनः Megh.ii.37, R.xii.66; 2. a pure and virtuous man.
उदंतक m. News, tidings.
उदंतिका f. Satisfaction, satiety.
उदन्या f. Thirst, निर्वर्त्यतामुदन्याप्रतीकारः Ve.vi.

उदय m. 1. Going upwards, rising, चंद्रोदय इवोदधेःR.xii.36, ii.73; 2. advancement, prosperity, तेजोद्वयस्य युगपद् व्यसनोदयाभ्याम् Sak.iv., R.ix.7; 3. the eastern mountain behind which the sun is supposed to rise; 4. creation, production, rise, आफलोदयकर्मणाम् R.i.5, K.S.iii.18, R.viii.22; 5. light, splendour; 6. result, consequence, R.i.15; 7. accomplishment, fulfilment, R.iii.1; 8. profit, revenue; 9. interest (i.e. premium paid for the use of money).
उदय-अचल, -अद्रि, -पर्वत, -गिरि, -शैल m. the eastern mountain behind which the sun rises, उदयगिरिवनालीबालमंदारपुष्पम् Ud., or श्रितोदयाद्रेरभिसायमुच्चकैः Sis.i.10.
उदय-अचल, -अद्रि, -पर्वत, -गिरि, -शैल m. the eastern mountain behind which the sun rises, उदयगिरिवनालीबालमंदारपुष्पम् Ud., or श्रितोदयाद्रेरभिसायमुच्चकैः Sis.i.10.
उदय-अचल, -अद्रि, -पर्वत, -गिरि, -शैल m. the eastern mountain behind which the sun rises, उदयगिरिवनालीबालमंदारपुष्पम् Ud., or श्रितोदयाद्रेरभिसायमुच्चकैः Sis.i.10.
उदय-अचल, -अद्रि, -पर्वत, -गिरि, -शैल m. the eastern mountain behind which the sun rises, उदयगिरिवनालीबालमंदारपुष्पम् Ud., or श्रितोदयाद्रेरभिसायमुच्चकैः Sis.i.10.
उदय-अचल, -अद्रि, -पर्वत, -गिरि, -शैल m. the eastern mountain behind which the sun rises, उदयगिरिवनालीबालमंदारपुष्पम् Ud., or श्रितोदयाद्रेरभिसायमुच्चकैः Sis.i.10.
उदय-प्रस्थ m. the plateau of the mountain behind which the sun rises.
उदयन (I) n. Rising, ascending.
उदयन (II) m. 1. A name of Agastya; 2. name of a celebrated king. (See App. II.)

उदर n. 1. The belly, उत्थानोच्छूनमंडूकपाटितोदरसंनिभे K.Pr.vii., M.iv.175; 2. cavity, interior or inside of anything, त्वां कारयामि कमलोदरबंधनस्थम् Sak.vi., R.v.70, Sant.S.i.5; 3. enlargement of the abdomen from dropsy or flatulence; 4. slaughter.

उदार a. (f. रा or री) 1. High, lofty, illustrious, munificent, R.v.12, viii.61, Bg.vii.1; 2. honest, sincere; 3. eloquent; 4. large, wide, broad, K.S.v.36; 5. beautiful, charming, K.S.vii.14, (the acc. sing. उदारम् is sometimes used adverbially, Sis.iv.33.)

उदार a. (f. रा or री) 1. High, lofty, illustrious, munificent, R.v.12, viii.61, Bg.vii.1; 2. honest, sincere; 3. eloquent; 4. large, wide, broad, K.S.v.36; 5. beautiful, charming, K.S.vii.14, (the acc. sing. उदारम् is sometimes used adverbially, Sis.iv.33.)
उदर-आध्मान n. flatulence of the body.
उदर-आवर्त m. the navel.
उदर-आवेष्ट m. the tapeworm.
उदर-त्राण n. an armour covering the front of the body, a belly-band.
उदर-पिशाच m. a glutton.
उदर-पूरम् ind. till the belly is full.
उदर-पोषण n. feeding the belly, supporting life.
उदरंभरि a. nourishing only one’s own belly, gluttonous.
उदर-शय m. fœtus.
उदर-सर्वस्व m. an epicure, a glutton.
उदरथि m. The ocean.
उदरिक a. (f. का) Having a large belly.
उदरिक a. (f. का) Having a large belly.
उदरिणी f. A pregnant woman.
उदरिल a. (f. ला) Fat, corpulent.
उदरिल a. (f. ला) Fat, corpulent.
उदर्क m. 1. The future result of an action, consequence. नत्वयमुदर्कः प्राक्तनस्य दुष्कृतस्य D.K., M.iv.76, xi.10; 2. future time, futurity.
उदर्चिस् (I) a. Shining or blazing upwards, R.vii.24, xv.76, K.S.iii.71, vii.79.
उदर्चिस् (II) m. 1. Fire, प्रक्षिप्योदर्चिषं कक्षे शेरते तेऽभिमारुतम् Sis.ii.42; 2. god of love; 3. Śiva.
उदश्रु a. One whose tears gush up, weeping, R.xii.14, Am.
उदसन n. Throwing up, raising, erecting.
उदात्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Elevated, high; 2. great, illustrious; 3. generous, bountiful; 4. dear, beloved; 5. highly or acutely accented.
उदात्त (II) m. 1. The acute accent (ताल्वादिषु सभागेषु स्थानेषूर्ध्वभागे निष्पन्नोऽनुदात्तः S.K.), निहंत्यरीनेकपदे य उदात्तः स्वरानिव Sis.ii.95; 2. a gift, donation; 3. a kind of musical instrument.
उदात्त (III) n. A figure of speech thus defined- उदात्तं वस्तुनः संपन्महतां चोपलक्षणम् K.Pr.x. (for an example, See Megh.ii.12-16.)
उदात्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Elevated, high; 2. great, illustrious; 3. generous, bountiful; 4. dear, beloved; 5. highly or acutely accented.
उदान m. 1. Breathing upwards; 2. one of the five vital airs (the other four being प्राण, अपान, व्यान and समान); it goes up and out at the throat; 3. the navel.
उद्दान n. 1. Confinement, उद्दाने क्रियमाणे तु मत्स्यानां तत्र रज्जुभिः Bh.; 2. taming, subduing; 3. the middle, the waist; 4. a fireplace; 5. submarine fire.
उदायुध a. (f. धा) With uplifted weapon, मनुजपशुभिर्निर्भर्यादैर्भवद्धिरुदायुधैः Ve.iii., R.xii.44.
उदायुध a. (f. धा) With uplifted weapon, मनुजपशुभिर्निर्भर्यादैर्भवद्धिरुदायुधैः Ve.iii., R.xii.44.

उदार a. (f. रा or री) 1. High, lofty, illustrious, munificent, R.v.12, viii.61, Bg.vii.1; 2. honest, sincere; 3. eloquent; 4. large, wide, broad, K.S.v.36; 5. beautiful, charming, K.S.vii.14, (the acc. sing. उदारम् is sometimes used adverbially, Sis.iv.33.)
उदार-चरित a. noble-minded, उदारचरितानां तु वसुधैव कुटुंबकम् Hit.i.
उदार-चेतस् a. high-minded, magnanimous.
उदार-धी a. 1. highly intelligent, R.iii.30; 2. noble-minded.
उदार-सत्व a. generous-minded.
उदास (I) a. (f. सा) Indifferent, apathetic.
उदास (II) m. 1. A stoic, a philosopher; 2. indifference, apathy.
उदास (I) a. (f. सा) Indifferent, apathetic.

उदासीन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Indifferent, free from affection, तद्दर्शिनमुदासीनं त्वामेव पुरुषं विदुः K.S.ii.13 (पुरुष is here called उदासीन, because in the Sāṅkhya doctrine souls are not supposed to have any part in the creation of the material universe); 2. not involved in a dispute; 3. neutral (as a king or nation).
उदासीन (II) n. 1. A stranger; 2. a neutral; 3. common acquaintance.

उदासीन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Indifferent, free from affection, तद्दर्शिनमुदासीनं त्वामेव पुरुषं विदुः K.S.ii.13 (पुरुष is here called उदासीन, because in the Sāṅkhya doctrine souls are not supposed to have any part in the creation of the material universe); 2. not involved in a dispute; 3. neutral (as a king or nation).
उदास्थित m. 1. A superintendent, a door-keeper; 2. spy, an emissary; 3. an ascetic who has given up his vow.
उदाहार m. 1. An example or illustration; 2. the beginning of a speech.
उद्दंश m. 1. A bug; 2. a louse.
उद्दंड a. (f. डा) Formidable, whose staff or stem is raised, (अंभः) उद्दंडपद्मं गृहदीर्घिकाणाम् R.xvi.46.
उद्दंड a. (f. डा) Formidable, whose staff or stem is raised, (अंभः) उद्दंडपद्मं गृहदीर्घिकाणाम् R.xvi.46.
उद्दंतुर a. (f. रा) 1. Large-toothed; 2. high, tall; 3. terrific, formidable.
उद्दंतुर a. (f. रा) 1. Large-toothed; 2. high, tall; 3. terrific, formidable.

उद्दाम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Unbound, unrestrained, free, स्रोतः स्युद्दामदिग्गजे R.i.78; 2. self-willed; 3. proud, haughty; 4. large, great, excessive, Megh.i.25.(उद्दामम् ind. means ‘violently,’ ‘without restraint,’ अद्योद्दामं ज्वलिष्यतः Ut.iii.)
उद्दाम (II) m. An epithet of Varuṇa.

उद्दाम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Unbound, unrestrained, free, स्रोतः स्युद्दामदिग्गजे R.i.78; 2. self-willed; 3. proud, haughty; 4. large, great, excessive, Megh.i.25.(उद्दामम् ind. means ‘violently,’ ‘without restraint,’ अद्योद्दामं ज्वलिष्यतः Ut.iii.)
उद्दालक n. A kind of honey.
